Source: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D212377
Access: readable in browser on2026-10-06T19:10:50.939Z.

Full browser timeline/inline requests inspected. Reviewer asks default visual-order keyboard navigation, ordinary click opens NewBook popup, real disabled property, retention of read-only/no-list capability states, and updated tests. Fake disabled class rejected because keyboard still activated it and stale class was not cleared. Author learned JS disabled setter handles HTML boolean attribute. Importing shared widget CSS exposed collisions with private address-book icon-button rules; temporary rename button-icon fixed this landing, but accepted review explicitly plans shared widgets and current source now uses icon-button. Do not canonize the temporary rename. Existing pane inert state makes old edit-time toolbar disabling loop redundant.

Exact source excerpts:
> I wouldn't hijack the tabindex for these and let the roving tab respect the visual hierarchy of these buttons.

> We shouldn't simulate the disabled state with classes since it doesn't really disable the item.

> The disabled property in JS will properly set the HTML attribute.

> Unfortunately the buttons had the same class as the widget.css ones and clashed. Missed to rename them in vCardTemplates.inc.xhtml to button-icon.

> Create a shared containers.css file in which we create a generic .sidebar-panel-header reusable class, so we share the same styling code between the folder pane and address book pane.
